item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 13/Aug/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring mainly fine weather to southeastern China in the next couple of days. An upper-air disturbance is expected to bring showers to the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Meari will move across Honshu of Japan and its adjacent seas today and tomorrow.
